page_title: SEV 2-1 MAL | Sevilla v Mallorca 22/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Sergi Darder flighted in the free kick and the ball found the head of Abdon Prats (Mallorca), whose excellent bullet header sailed into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
90+4' It seemed like Sergi Darder (Mallorca) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+4' Quique Sanchez Flores decides to make a substitution. Jesus Navas will be replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Erik Lamela (Sevilla) has come on for Youssef En Nesyri.
86' Dangerous play by Sergio Ramos (Sevilla). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Vedat Muriqi is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
81' It's time for a substitution. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) comes on in place of Isaac Romero.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is coming onto the pitch as Nemanja Gudelj cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
77' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Hernandez saw the whole situation.
75' 2 - 0 Goal! Youssef En Nesyri plays it to Isaac Romero (Sevilla), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Predrag Rajkovic. 2:0.
73' Jose Copete (Mallorca) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
73' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Valjent trots off the pitch and is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
71' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) replaces Omar Mascarell.
71' Substitution. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Daniel Rodriguez walks off.
69' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' The attendance for today's match is 35203.

61' 1 - 0 Goal! Suso hands Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
60' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cyle Larin (Mallorca) replacing Nemanja Radonjic.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

59' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
59' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
55' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
54' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:4.
52' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
51' Surely that's handball by one of the Mallorca players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
49' Suso (Sevilla) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Quique Sanchez Flores probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lucien Agoume (Sevilla). He is replaced by Suso.
46' The whistle blows and Alejandro Hernandez starts the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
43' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
40' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
31' 3:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
28' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
26' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
25' It looks like Loic Bade (Sevilla) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Hernandez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
21' Samu Costa (Mallorca) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
20' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
16' Flag goes up against Samu Costa (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

13' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Orjan Nyland didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
13' Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
10' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
4' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
3' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Orjan Nyland (Sevilla).
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
1' The first half has started.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
